[
دَلَّةٌ , to which Golius assigns a meaning partly belonging to دَلْدَلَةٌ, an inf. n. of دَلْدَلَ, and partly to other words of this art, (“ Capitis membrorumve motus seu gestus, extrinsecus gravitatem præ se ferens, profectus tamen ab eo qui amat favetque, ”) as on the authority of the K and KL, I do not find in either of those works.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
